notes.title: 1.0 Hotfix 2
notes.notes: First time players are forced to set the game's language. This prevents non-English speaking players from getting stuck in the menu.

notes.title: Game Release (with a note from the Dev)
notes.notes:
Hi, I'm Flavian.

After four months of hard work, I'm excited to announce that Fool's Gambit is finally released and available for purchase. This is the first commercial game I've worked on, and while I don’t have any specific expectations for sales, I’m just thrilled to have something out there for people to play and enjoy!

This week, I’ll be focusing on tracking down any unseen bugs or glitches to patch them, aiming to have a fully polished game build ready by the weekend. I’ll also do my best to respond to questions and reviews from players on Steam.

As for the game's future, I plan to work on it periodically. Some content I’d love to add includes more cards, items, passives, and eventually, multiplayer. However, I can’t provide any specific timelines for these updates, as my current job takes up a significant portion of my time at the moment.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out! I’ll also be keeping an eye on social media to see players’ reactions. 

Thank you, and I hope you have fun playing my game!
